label: copy-phase input f fed back early in recall (recall_idx 2-4), not at last step
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the fed-back input token is the letter f (i.e. orig(1..3) == f being re-input at recall_idx 2-4). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, never on any other input token, and essentially never when f is re-input as orig(0) (recall_idx 1) or late (recall_idx >= 5). Mostly silent at the final step (to_go == 0). Magnitude is largest at recall_idx 2 (f was the second original token; all top examples are of this form, about 59% of mass) and decreases at recall_idx 3 and 4; weakest activations occur near the end of the sequence (small to_go) and for short L. Dev F1 0.92, mass recall 0.998.

issues: Main source of false positives: in the recall_idx 4 slice (f fed back as orig(3)), precision on test is only 0.63 with to_go>=1, falling to 0.41 at L=6 / to_go=1 and about 0.70 for L>=7. I looked for a history rule that separates firing from silent cases (correct, in_count, digits or vowels among earlier originals, n_digits) and found none; every slice sits at 0.66-0.77. So these look like weak activations near the firing threshold, not a separate class. The explanation already calls recall_idx 4 weaker. The slice holds about 5% of activation mass, and on the dev split 65% of its covered actives fall in the lowest activation quartile.
A smaller false-positive pocket: recall_idx 2 with to_go=1 (only L=4) has test precision 0.51. This matches the stated weakness for L=4 and small to_go.

Factual claims check out. Firing is copy-phase only (the original and delimiter phases have zero actives). in_tok is f 100% of the time. recall_idx 2/3/4 hold 0.59/0.36/0.05 of the mass; recall_idx 1 holds 0.002 and recall_idx >=5 about 0. to_go=0 has 58 actives out of 36.5k. recall_idx 2 covers about 94% of the top activation quartile.
Missed activations (795 on test, 0.2% of mass) are scattered tiny activations (0.00-0.07 relative), mostly f at recall_idx 1. There is no systematic class.
Alternative predicates did not beat the original in a meaningful way. recall 2-3 only: F1 0.864. Allowing recall_idx 4 only when to_go>=2: F1 0.925 vs 0.921, which is not significant.
